action.title: Action
action.core_event: The Mercy Scene: the hero is at the villain’s mercy, at their weakest against the villain’s greatest power, and must turn the tables through the final tactic and expressed gift.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Defeat the antagonist or evil force
Save an individual, group, society, or environment from harm
Secure or destroy a dangerous MacGuffin
Restore order and peace

horror.title: Horror
horror.global_value_axis: Life / Death, deepening to Damnation or another fate worse than death
horror.core_event: The Confrontation with Evil: the protagonist faces the fully revealed horror in a final showdown whose outcome determines survival, death, or a fate worse than death.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Survive and escape
Understand the source and rules of the horror
Protect loved ones or innocents
Destroy, neutralize, contain, or outlast the horror

crime.title: Crime
crime.core_event: The Exposure of the Criminal: the criminal’s identity, method, motive, or social defection is revealed. Punishment may follow or fail; exposure itself is the indispensable audience payoff.
crime.core_emotion: Intrigue, curiosity, and the satisfaction of the penny dropping
conscious_objects_of_desire: Solve the crime and identify who is responsible
Expose or bring the perpetrator to justice
Exonerate the wrongly accused or oneself
Commit the perfect crime and escape justice when told from the criminal’s perspective

love.title: Love
love.core_event: The Proof of Love Scene: one or both lovers make a sacrificial or vulnerable action that proves genuine love rather than infatuation, lust, convenience, or possession.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Win the beloved’s affection
Overcome internal and external barriers to be together
Achieve mutual understanding and respect
Secure a shared future or meaningful commitment

performance.title: Performance
performance.core_event: The Big Performance Scene: under decisive pressure, the protagonist unconditionally expresses—or betrays, withholds, or corrupts—their unique gift.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Win or gain access to the major performance opportunity
Master and express the gift
Earn respect from audience, peers, mentor, or self
Defeat a rival or standard without surrendering the authentic gift

western.title: Western
western.core_event: The Big Showdown: hero and villain face off in a decisive test of individual sovereignty, protection of the community, and the price of chosen duty.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Stop the oppressor’s plan
Protect the victim or community
Preserve or redefine personal autonomy
Restore conditions in which the community can govern itself

society.title: Society
society.core_event: The Revolution Scene: the protagonist’s or luminaries’ gifts are expressed or refused and power visibly changes hands—or fails to change hands.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Expose hypocrisy and lies of the reigning power
Gain recognition and rights for the disenfranchised
Create social or political change
Overthrow, reform, capture, or redistribute institutional power

thriller.title: Thriller
thriller.core_event: Hero at the Mercy of the Villain: the protagonist’s pursuit of safety is most threatened, a fate worse than death becomes possible, and the outcome depends on how the protagonist unleashes—or fails to unleash—the unique gift.
conscious_objects_of_desire: Unmask and stop the master villain
Prevent further victimization
Use the unique gift to outwit or overpower the antagonist
Restore personal and societal safety

war.title: War
war.core_event: The Big Battle: the climactic organized conflict in which courage, strategy, kinship, and willingness to sacrifice are tested and the meaning of the sacrifice is established.
war.core_emotion: Intrigue: fascination with how the characters will contend with an apparently impossible situation
conscious_objects_of_desire: Fulfill or prevent the military objective
Protect comrades, civilians, homeland, or kin
Survive or achieve victory without forfeiting honor
Expose, resist, or obey a command whose moral legitimacy is contested
